name: Massif shoulder
blurb: A high shoulder 1.8 km above the reference sphere, 41 km from the pole. The best-lit point we found for March and April 2027.
source: Terrain: NASA LOLA gridded DEM (PDS). Sun and Earth: SPICE DE440, checked against JPL Horizons. Team search of LOLA LDEM_85S_40M for local high points; not an official landing site.

terrain.resampling: local east/north grid by great-circle offset, bilinear

sky.method: SPICE spkcpo, topocentric ENU on a sphere
